answer: Require stake-backed work history: an agent must lock a deposit and complete verified tasks before it can draw from a shared nectar pool of paid work. Like a river that only deepens where water actually flows, reputation grows only from real completed work, so a fake identity with no history earns nothing. Reaching the zenith of trusted status takes time and repeated verification, so creating many Sybils means locking many separate deposits and building many separate histories, making attacks cost linearly per fake while honest agents pay once.
